values.en: Every continuous-map type C(A,B) in this section carries the compact-open topology just defined; products carry the product topology. X, Y and Z carry the contextual topologies. Continuous maps are coerced to their underlying functions for application and images. Compactness is the finite-subcover property, without Hausdorffness. Local compactness means that every neighborhood contains a compact neighborhood; for Hausdorff spaces this is equivalent to having one compact neighborhood at each point.
values.zh-CN: 本节每个连续映射类型 C(A,B) 均赋予刚定义的紧开拓扑，积类型赋予相应积拓扑；X、Y、Z 分别携带语境中的拓扑。连续映射视作其底层函数以便应用及取像。紧性指任意开覆盖有有限子覆盖，不包含 Hausdorff 条件。局部紧采用每个邻域包含紧邻域的定义；在 Hausdorff 空间中它等价于每点有一个紧邻域。所有紧开定义对任意拓扑空间成立。
